Alexis Saelemaekers.note: Watch Saelemaekers for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Alexis Saelemaekers.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。留意他如何传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Amadou Onana.note: Watch Onana for creating a better angle for the next pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Amadou Onana.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Arthur Theate.note: Watch Theate for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Arthur Theate.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Axel Witsel.note: Witsel's signature is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Axel Witsel.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断上。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Brandon Mechele.note: Mechele is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Brandon Mechele.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Charles De Ketelaere.note: Ketelaere's edge is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Charles De Ketelaere.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Diego Moreira.note: Watch Moreira for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Diego Moreira.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Dodi Lukebakio.note: Lukébakio's signature is using strength without slowing the next action. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Dodi Lukebakio.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步上。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Hans Vanaken.note: Vanaken is defined by reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Hans Vanaken.noteZh: 他靠在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Jeremy Doku.note: Watch Doku for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Jeremy Doku.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Joaquin Seys.note: Watch Seys for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Joaquin Seys.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。留意他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Kevin De Bruyne.note: Bruyne stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Kevin De Bruyne.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Koni De Winter.note: Winter's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Koni De Winter.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Leandro Trossard.note: Trossard is defined by starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Leandro Trossard.noteZh: 他靠在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动与同位置球员拉开差异。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Matias Fernandez-Pardo.note: Fernandez-Pardo's edge is carrying momentum through open midfield. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Matias Fernandez-Pardo.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Maxim De Cuyper.note: Cuyper stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Maxim De Cuyper.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Mike Penders.note: Penders stands out for staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Mike Penders.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Nathan Ngoy.note: Ngoy stands out for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Nathan Ngoy.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Nicolas Raskin.note: Raskin's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Nicolas Raskin.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Romelu Lukaku.note: Watch Lukaku for giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Romelu Lukaku.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Senne Lammens.note: Lammens is defined by staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Senne Lammens.noteZh: 他靠在射门方向明确前保持身体平衡与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Thibaut Courtois.note: Watch Courtois for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Thibaut Courtois.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。留意他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Thomas Meunier.note: Meunier's edge is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Thomas Meunier.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Timothy Castagne.note: Castagne's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Timothy Castagne.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构上。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Youri Tielemans.note: Tielemans stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Youri Tielemans.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Zeno Debast.note: Debast is defined by moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Zeno Debast.noteZh: 他靠用传球的力度和角度移动防线与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。
